item.name: Get creators' payment info collection status

request.name: Get creators' payment info collection status

description.content:
Returns a paginated list describing, per creator, whether payment info,
tax info and approval have been collected. Replaces the legacy Creator
Payment Info Status report and lets you identify creators whose payouts
are blocked pending information.

query.description: Base64 keyset pagination cursor. Pass the `EndCursor` (forward) or `StartCursor` (backward) from the previous response's `Metadata.Pagination`. Omit on the first request.
(Required) Number of items to return per page. Must be a positive integer, capped at 200.
(Required) Pagination direction relative to the supplied cursor.
(Required) Sort order for the selected `SortField`.
Filters by whether the creator is payable (eligible to be paid).
Comma-separated list of payment-info statuses to filter by. Valid values: Not Submitted, Received, Invalid.
Filters by approval state. `true` (approved), `false` (not approved) or `null` (no approval required).

Returns a paginated list of the authenticated partner's payouts in the
creator view. Payouts are referenced exclusively by their customer-facing
`PayoutID`; the internal payout identifier is never exposed.

query.description: Base64 keyset pagination cursor. Pass the `EndCursor` (forward) or `StartCursor` (backward) from the previous response's `Metadata.Pagination`. Omit on the first request.
(Required) Number of items to return per page. Must be a positive integer, capped at 200.
(Required) Pagination direction relative to the supplied cursor.
(Required) Sort order for the selected `SortField`.
(Required) Field to sort by. One of: PayoutDate, PublisherID, CreatedAt.
Filters payouts by creator (publisher) id.
Comma-separated list of division ids to filter by. Each entry must be a positive integer or the literal `null` (payouts with no division).
Returns payouts with a payout date on or after this ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.
Returns payouts with a payout date on or before this ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

Comma-separated list of payout statuses to include. Mutually exclusive with `ExcludePayoutStatus`. `NO ACCOUNT` is not accepted as a filter value. Valid values: READY, UNPAYABLE, BELOW MINIMUM, SUBMITTED, PROCESSING, SENT, SUBMISSION FAILED, PAID, CANCELLED, FAILED.
Comma-separated list of payout statuses to exclude. Mutually exclusive with `IncludePayoutStatus`. `NO ACCOUNT` is not accepted as a filter value.
Comma-separated list of ISO 4217 currency codes to filter by.
Filters by whether the creator is currently payable.
When `true`, cancelled payouts are omitted from the response.

description.content: Added as a part of security scheme: apikey

The Payments API exposes read-only access to a partner's creator payouts,
payables and creator payment-info collection status. It is the public
counterpart of the CreatorIQ Payments product and lets integrators reconcile
payout data, monitor payable statuses and track which creators still need to
submit their payment information.

## Key Use Cases:
- **Reconcile payouts**: Retrieve a paginated list of payouts (creator view) with amounts, statuses and payout dates to reconcile against your own ledger.
- **Track payables**: List individual payables with their campaign, currency, due/completion dates and current status.
- **Monitor payment-info collection**: Identify creators whose payment info, tax info or approval is still pending so payouts are not blocked.

## Authentication
All requests are authenticated with your API key sent in the `X-API-KEY`
header. The platform gateway validates the key and implicitly scopes every
response to the authenticated partner (and division, when the key is
division-scoped).

## Pagination
All endpoints use keyset (cursor) pagination. Send `PageSize`, `Direction`,
`SortField` and `SortOrder` on the first request, then pass the `EndCursor`
(forward) or `StartCursor` (backward) returned in `Metadata.Pagination` as the
`Cursor` value to fetch the next page.
